description: Authoritative FR and NFR requirement mapping to implementation phases and acceptance signals.

requirements.acceptance_signal: Configurable browser command opens focused surface
Search input owns focus before text input without pointer use
Eligible tab projection fields match query correctly
Live query revision renders matching result revision
Deterministic ranking order and provenance score
Contextual result display distinguishes duplicate titles
Keyboard Enter activates intended tab and window
Escape dismisses search without mutating tab selection
Browser tab events reconcile without duplicate IDs
Full snapshot recovery restores projection consistency
Stale activation result prevented from activating wrong tab
Health freshness and lifecycle status observable
Persistence failure degrades storage while lexical query succeeds
Profile isolation and private-context ephemeral handling
Reset and uninstall remove only InfoBoard-owned paths
Command dispatch to focus p95 <= 100 ms
Query to render 1,000 tabs p95 <= 50 ms
Selection to activation p95 <= 100 ms
Deterministic ranking checksum reproducibility
Snapshot convergence guarantees zero drift
Host recovery and rebuild without reinstall
Zero network requests and local hot path only
Pointer-free accessibility, visible focus, contrast
Privacy deny-by-default and redaction enforcement
Six-row cross-platform matrix evidence
